creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-3, Delivery, end of stage 1. Stage 2 moves the mirror, input, bridge and shell at once, so the assumptions most likely to be wrong should be tested before it starts: the replay in a real surface, input side effects on the surface, latency with a real bridge, and flow control over ssh.

A throwaway slice, not merged into the app's code path: one pane in a real libghostty surface on `muster-daemon`, with daemon-side input (events also fed to the surface, its writes discarded), attach and detach, measured in the latency tier against the bare-PTY row. The MIP's targets: median within 0.5 ms of bare PTY, p95 within 1 ms with no second mode, one byte on the stream per echoed byte plus framing.

What it finds goes into MIP-3 before stage 2 starts.
title: Vertical slice: one real pane on muster-daemon, measured before the cut-over
